title: Smith provider — format-agent.yaml
description: Per-kind YAML describing the sub-agent / chat-mode-agent artefact for a provider. Documents the artefact's frontmatter spec, body authoring conventions, and the built-in tools available to the agent.

example.description: Relative path to the companion example file under example/. Filename MUST start with example-agent and may carry a provider-specific suffix before the extension (e.g. example-agent.agent.md).

builtin_tools.description: Tools (or tool sets) available to the agent out of the box.

default.description: Default value (any type) — use null for none.

allowed.description: Allowed values — string description or array of literals.
